Bug_Details:
Using the standard getClassLoader() may not return the right class loader in a JEE context. Instead, go through the currentThread .
Noncompliant code example
ClassLoader cl = this.getClass().getClassLoader();  // Noncompliant
Compliant solution
ClassLoader cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the'showBug' method where it uses the standard getClassLoader() method to obtain the ClassLoader. This may not return the right class loader in a JEE context.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the obtained class loader from the showBug method is not the same as the expected class loader (the context class loader of the current thread).
